answer: The Coordination Work Toll makes each new agent identity solve a shared scheduling puzzle alongside every other identity registered in the same block. At zenith load the puzzle depth scales with total identity count, so spawning 500 fakes multiplies each identity's opal fee fifty-fold. The echo cost per fake identity is one hour of unscaled CPU plus 0.01 opal, which prices the act of coordinating them together rather than merely detecting them.
